s: Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy, Repository, Middleware
d: Design patterns are proven solutions to recurring problems. They make your code more maintainable, testable, and communicable. Backend-specific patterns like Repository, Middleware, and Circuit Breaker appear in every production system.
c: Behavioral: Observer, Strategy, Command, Chain of Responsibility

p: Design Patterns is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
